children: The auto component maker will add capacity in aluminium casting, alloy wheels and moulding while setting up a new plant in Maharashtra
Uno Minda is planning to invest around Rs 1,415 crore across four projects as it looks to increase production capacity and meet growing demand from automakers.

The projects will cover aluminium casting, two-wheeler alloy wheels, moulding, and interior and exterior automotive components. The company said the investments are aimed at expanding its manufacturing footprint and bringing production closer to key customer locations.

The largest expansion within Uno Minda’s existing operations will be a new aluminium casting plant in Hosur, Tamil Nadu. The company plans to invest around Rs 510 crore in the facility, which will be built on an existing land parcel on Thally Road.

The expansion will take aluminium casting capacity at the Hosur location from around 13,000 metric tonnes to 34,000 metric tonnes at peak. The plant will make components for internal combustion engine (ICE) and electric vehicles (EVs), including powertrain and structural applications.
The first phase is expected to start production by Q4 FY28, with the existing Hosur operations planned to move to the new facility by Q1 FY29.

Uno Minda will spend around Rs 155 crore on a new two-wheeler alloy wheel plant at Kharkhoda, Haryana. The facility will have a capacity of 3.3 million units and will include 2 million units of capacity being shifted from Supa, Maharashtra.
The company will also invest around Rs 80 crore to expand its moulding facility in Bengaluru. The expansion is expected to start operations by Q1 FY28.
Separately, Toyoda Gosei South India, the company’s joint venture with Japan’s Toyoda Gosei, will invest around Rs 670 crore in a new plant at Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Maharashtra.
The facility will manufacture interior and exterior components, airbags, hoses and body sealing parts. It is expected to begin operations by Q4 FY29.
Uno Minda said the investments are backed by customer demand and will help the company expand its presence across key automotive component segments.
